newsitem.title: FRANCE: Canal+ rises on Bertelsmann TV exit.
newsitem.headline: Canal+ rises on Bertelsmann TV exit.

text.p: Canal Plus shares rose on Thursday on the back of news that German media giant Bertelsmann is pulling the plug on plans to launch a digital pay-television system with Luxembourg's CLT, traders said.

"The postponement sine die of the Bertelsmann/CLT project leaves the door open for Canal Plus for the whole of Europe," said one operator. "With its merger with Nethold, Canal Plus' leadership will not be disputed."
Shares in the French pay-TV company were up 2.51 percent at 1,184 francs at 1334 GMT.
